name: motif_add_allomorph_required_features
description:
Add Required Features. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if one affix form is chosen by the word's inflection features, not by sound; otherwise use an environment for sound, or compose-author-feature-structure for the whole affix (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages Required Features on an ordinary affix allomorph in a Draft. Populate the returned structure with feature values to select the form by the stem's grammatical features, including on derivational affixes. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-allomorph-required-features. Agent class: Draft.

allomorph.description: Ordinary affix allomorph id with no existing Required Features structure. May be earlier-staged.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
